  "query": "SELECT d37208_product_class_name AS \"产品名称\", SUM(d37208_incident_count) AS \"工单数量\" FROM t_data_assistant_incident WHERE d37208_incident_month = DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 1 YEAR), '%Y-06') GROUP BY d37208_product_class_name ORDER BY SUM(d37208_incident_count) ASC LIMIT 3",
  "reasoning": "The user wants to find the 3 products with the fewest incidents in June of the previous year. Then, I will group the results by product name (`d37208_product_class_name`) and calculate the total number of incidents (`d37208_incident_count`) for each product. Finally, I will sort these products in ascending order based on their incident count and select the top 3."
}
```
